items.title: Safety

items:
Summary:

You’ve found the quintessential 30A vacation! In the Seacrest Beach community of Scenic Hwy 30A sits Lighthouse30A, a serene getaway offering a spacious layout perfect for family groups & extended ‘workcations’. Refined luxuries make relaxation easy. It’s the location that really shines. A short walk or seasonal shuttle to the community’s lagoon-style private pool – largest in the state -- and deeded access private beach. Also a palm-tree lined stroll to the lively Rosemary Beach town center.



The Neighborhood:

*Private beach access with beach chair service (3 min shuttle ride or 10 min walk)

*5 min walk to 12,000-square-foot, Private Resort Pool with beach cafe

*Seasonal (Mar-Oct) Shuttle picks up right outside the front door and provides transportation to the beach and pool from 9 AM to 5:30 PM

*2 min walk to Village of South Walton with Starbucks, bike rentals, restaurants, shops, & live music

*5 min walk to Rosemary Beach with farmer's market, great shopping, & best dining on 30A

*Close to local favorite "hidden gems" like Crabby Steve's, the only beachfront Tiki bar along 30A

*1.3 miles of shaded walking trails winding through the community



Getting Around:

The home provides 4 free bikes. The community offers a seasonal shuttle (March to October) with convenient pick-up and drop-off areas.



Interaction with Guests:

PMI Destin is the locally owned and operated area affiliate of Property Management Inc. (PMI), the nation’s fastest-growing professional property management company. We are available by phone, text, and email. We are here to make sure your stay is relaxing and enjoyable!



Cleaning protocols follow PMI Purify with disinfecting of all high-touch surfaces.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
